title: Associativity of the descended derived pullback tensor comparison
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and derived pullback $L=Lg^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $F$ be an additive functor between the categories of sheaves of modules, identified on objects and morphisms with the tensor-formula module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]: supply equalities $h_M:F(M)=g^*M$ and require $F(a)=h_M;g^*(a);h_N^{-1}$. Let $\epsilon:Q_hL\to K(F)Q_h$ exhibit $L$ as a left-derived functor for quasi-isomorphisms. For every pair of complexes $P,N$, supply an isomorphism $\varphi_{P,N}:F\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes FN)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Give $F$ a strong monoidal structure $m_F$, and require that for every $p+q=n$, $F(\iota_{p,q});\varphi_{P,N}^n=\mu_{m_F}(P^p,N^q)^{-1};\iota_{p,q}$, where $\iota$ is the corresponding summand inclusion in the total tensor complex. Give a natural isomorphism of bifunctors $\mu:(A,B)\mapsto LA\otimes LB\cong(A,B)\mapsto L(A\otimes B)$. Assume for every K-flat pair $P,N$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] that $\mu_{QP,QN};L(\mu_Q(P,N));\epsilon_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)};Q(\varphi_{P,N})=(\epsilon_P\otimes\epsilon_N);\mu_Q(FP,FN)$. Then for every $A,B,C\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $(\mu_{A,B}\otimes1_{LC});\mu_{A\otimes B,C};L(\alpha_{A,B,C})=\alpha_{LA,LB,LC};(1_{LA}\otimes\mu_{B,C});\mu_{A,B\otimes C}$. This asserts associativity only, and requires no derived unit comparison.

proof.text: Choose K-flat representatives of A,B,C. Their two bracketed tensor products remain K-flat, so the supplied computation applies to all tensorators in the associativity diagram. Compose both sides with the invertible localization tensorators and the counits computing L on K-flat inputs.

In degree n precompose by every triple summand inclusion indexed by p+q+r=n. The summand formula for phi replaces each occurrence by the inverse tensorator of m_F. The resulting diagram is precisely associativity of the supplied CoreMonoidal structure m_F. Coproduct extensionality proves equality of the maps of complexes. Applying Q and cancelling the isomorphisms proves the identity on the chosen K-flat representatives.
Both composites are natural in all three variables, because mu is an isomorphism of bifunctors. Naturality transports the identity along the three resolution isomorphisms to A,B,C.

theorem derivedPullback_tensor_associativity {T X : Scheme.{uModel}} (g : T ⟶ X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wModel} (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wModel} (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))
    (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M = Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj g M)
    (hmap : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N),
      F.map a = eqToHom (hF M) ≫ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackMap g a ≫
        eqToHom (hF N).symm)
    [F.Additive]
    (mF : F.CoreMonoidal)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback g ⟶
      F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hε : (derivedPullback g).IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (φ : ∀ P N : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _)) ≅
          CochainComplex.mapBifunctor
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N) (curriedTensor _))
    (hφ : ∀ P N p q n (h : p + q = n),
          F.map (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _)
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫ (φ P N).hom.f n =
            (mF.μIso (P.X p) (N.X q)).inv ≫
              HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)
                (curriedTensor _) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q n h)
    (μ : curriedTensorPre (derivedPullback g) ≅ curriedTensorPost (derivedPullback g))
    (hμ : ∀ P N : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P →
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N →
          ((μ.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)).hom ≫
              (derivedPullback g).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q P N) ≫
              ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
                (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _))) ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map (φ P N).hom =
            (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) ⊗ₘ
              ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)) ≫
              Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N))
    : ∀ A B C : schemeDerivedCategory X,
        ((μ.app A).app B).hom ▷ (derivedPullback g).obj C ≫
            ((μ.app (A ⊗ B)).app C).hom ≫ (derivedPullback g).map (α_ A B C).hom =
          (α_ ((derivedPullback g).obj A) ((derivedPullback g).obj B)
            ((derivedPullback g).obj C)).hom ≫
            (derivedPullback g).obj A ◁ ((μ.app B).app C).hom ≫
            ((μ.app A).app (B ⊗ C)).hom
